name: private-service-relations
goal: Keep single-owner instantiated service classes in their owner relationships while excluding them from the global shared catalog

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The current catalog ignores related context for services, so source-proven single-owner classes disappear from their owner’s Uses group. Global Services must continue excluding those classes.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Catalog cases cover global eligibility; relation cases use shared classes. Strengthen the existing linked-entity case and shared paging fixture with nine valid instantiated single-owner classes, owner links, false shared flags and global exclusion.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Sealed red 06f06999 at 5115107d4 fails the unchanged owner-relationship assertion for nine valid single-owner instantiated classes. Fixture, formatting, types and lint pass; the global exclusion assertions remain in the same test.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: a4b95aff0 retains valid private classes in owner relationships, derives shared status from the same owner set and preserves every declaration, construction and method guard. The existing context option is documented.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged sealed green d22555f4 at a4b95aff0 passes twelve standard catalog/relationship unit cases and thirty-nine browser cases. Paired red 074dcebd at ebd8c2f86 fails actual private-class visibility; global exclusion and four-item paging remain asserted.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Current proof a80ff5be at 9497fac05 passes 51 unchanged cases; red is 140f20a4 at 427300dee. All 723 original images decode and match revision/hash metadata; eight contact sheets and owner-detail crops were inspected. Types, lint, audit and the canonical registry pass.
